annotations.title: List a domain portfolio by expiry date

description: Look up the registry expiry date and registrar of up to 25 domain names a person owns and list them soonest first, flagging names that expire within 60 days (or a chosen window), have passed their expiry date, or are no longer registered. Use it when someone asks which domains to renew or what is expiring; use check_domain_availability instead for names they do not own yet, and appraise_domain to decide whether a name is worth renewing. Expiry comes from each registry's RDAP record and a registrar renewal can take a day to show. Read-only, free, no key; one or two DNS and RDAP requests per uncached name, runs no valuation.

domains.description: The portfolio's domain names, 1 to 25, such as ["example.com", "example.io"].

withinDays.description: Flag names expiring within this many days, 1 to 365. Defaults to 60.

name: check_portfolio_renewals

budget.description: This request's uncached-lookup budget: lane (free or keyed), used, limit, remaining, and keyRejected when a key was sent and refused. Cached names cost nothing.

citeAs.description: A structured citation. Quote `text` or build your own from the fields. Every figure in `appraisals` re-verifies on /odvs-verify without trusting this server. Tools whose answer is not an appraisal (a bracket, which withholds estimates by contract, and the recorded-sales tools, whose rows are not hashed) return an empty `appraisals`.

items.description: One appraisal holding exactly the fields its ODVS hashes commit to. Paste it into https://audit.domains/odvs-verify/ to recompute all three hashes client-side. appraisalHash is the appraisal's identity; resultDigest checks the output only.

confidence.description: Internal 0-100 model score, NOT a probability.

methodologyVersion.description: The methodology revision hashed into this record (as rev-<value>, or rev-n/a when null). It, not citeAs.revision, produced the figure.

edition.description: ODVS edition id; null until editions are published.

revision.description: The methodology revision live on the server at retrieval. A record's own methodologyVersion is what produced its figure and can differ.

limit.description: Present with pending: code lookup_limit, retryable, retryAfterSeconds, and retry ({tool, arguments}: send it unchanged after that wait to continue exactly where this call stopped). Where a key lifts the limit, upgrade says how.

pending.description: Names not checked because the lookup limit was reached. limit.retry is the call that checks them.

sellUrl.description: Present when names are due: where to list a name for sale here instead of letting it lapse.

title: List a domain portfolio by expiry date
